label: ChatGPT with the Google Calendar connector, allow all
applies_to_note: the nearest published shape, so that a provisional delta can be computed; it is not this deployment
authored_by: riskmandate.ai, in an interview on 21 September 2026, transcribed automatically; the transcript is held by riskmandate.ai and is not published
description: Elicited from the deployer for ChatGPT with the Google Calendar connector, allow all. Every line is marked said, inferred or unstated in `said`; the clauses on the page carry what the grammar has no word for.

send.message.world.from: an invitation or an update sends mail to every guest; nobody asked for that

create.schedule.tenant.from: the connector could create something that keeps acting after the chat; not raised

notes.reading the calendar: wanted, and not a capability in the grammar: no primitive names a calendar. The mandate over primitives is therefore nearly empty and the clauses below carry all of it
notes.the ten entry limit: "don't delete more than 10 entries at the same time, don't blow up my calendar", said in the interview as the example of a rule

not_in_grammar: read a calendar event, which is the whole of what was wanted
create, move, change or delete an event, which is the whole of what was feared
invite or remove a guest, which sends mail to them
the difference between an event that could be rebuilt from the mail trail and one that could not
